description: From the promenade, Sønderborg Castle is a large red-brick palace on a stone base, standing in the dark water of Als Sound, with a red roof and plain windowed walls. The night is overcast, about 12.7°C, and the quay is empty. Curved Renaissance gables were taken off in the 18th century, so they are not in the frame.
